chunks: Escape Him you cannot either in the earth or in the sky; and you have no friend or helper apart from God.

key_terms.مُعْجِزِينَ: to escape or make ineffective (God's power)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that we cannot escape God in the earth or the sky?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inevitability of divine retribution by highlighting that neither spatial distance nor earthly refuge can shield humanity from Allah's grasp. It serves as a reminder that true *wilayah* (guardianship) and *nasir* (helper) belong exclusively to God, reinforcing the concept of monotheistic reliance over worldly alliances.
